proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal on Lobbying Disclosure
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual report disclosing IBM's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, recipients, and board/management oversight of lobbying expenditures.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal on Shareholder Ability to Call a Special Shareholder Meeting
proposals.topic_summary: Asks board to amend bylaws so holders of 10% of outstanding common stock can call a special shareholder meeting.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal to Have an Independent Board Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests policy requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director, with phase-in permitted for the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.
